notes.title: Metonymy's First Patch
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30644632/482aab46b7d21602b3a405ab95e44113169150f5.jpg

After releasing Metonymy on steam just a few weeks ago we received a lot of feedback. Much of which was awesome, and we have gone ahead and tried to implement some of the fixes you all suggested. So here it is, Metonymy's First Patch Notes.

Keyboard and Controller Support

    The start screen has been fixed allowing for a majority of Keyboard and Controller inputs to now actually start the game. 
    The Arrow Keys now navigate menus and can now be used to navigate the player as well.


Hints

     We have added a small amount of hints in the game to help people better understand how to play. These can be seen in the loading screen and soon after the player gains control of Enoch.


Graphical Settings

     Upon launching the game there will only be one option for graphical settings. its listed as Fantastic. Previously the default setting was un-optimized, and the visual style of Metonymy was lost. However, this also means that the game might not run smoothly on lower end computers and If this is the case I suggest comparing your computer specs to the recommended ones listed on the store page.


Thanks For Playing
